hypothesis: Individual risk coefficients may track changing context after completed disturbances; compare against changes in baseline risk alone.
source: frozen training-person HNE model, unchanged basis and coefficients as prior center
feedback: only same-person labels whose full target block ends by the completed current day
prior: L2 around source coefficient and natural-prior intercept; intercept/affine controls center at 0/1
loss: unweighted Bernoulli negative log-likelihood over past mature origins plus prior penalty; single-class buffers are allowed
selection: validation-person prequential AUROC, ties lower C; all conditions reported
